rationale: Y independently rediscovers the exact ground-truth inline concern (unconditional `quality` assignment vs sibling provided_fields+not-None guards) at the identical file:line pairs (serving_video.py:203, serving_video_output_stream.py:538) and shows the PR's 'resolved' fix is still incomplete — a precise, high-value recall hit X entirely misses. Y also surfaces a well-evidenced, novel CI-marker deselection bug and grounds claims in greps/quoted code/CI configs, giving stronger verification confidence. X is deep and well-argued (and both converge independently on the custom-enabler disable() bug and the H200/L20X hardware mismatch), but its top 'major' finding about quality being a cross-model no-op is undercut by the PR author's explicit statement that H3-scoping was intentional, and several findings rely on unverifiable speculative failure chains.
